The script sets `DROP = {2, 6, 10, 15}`, dropping block 15 instead of block 14, which violates Required result 1 ("Remove every tensor of blocks 2, 6, 10, 14") and consequently the renumbering map in Required result 2 (old 14 would become 11, and old 15 would be dropped rather than mapped). The output would still have 184 tensors with contiguous indices 0..11, so the required checks pass silently, but grading against the hidden reference fails because the tensor values at new index 11 come from old block 14's replacement — the surviving set is wrong. Everything else (name preservation, non-block tensors, single output file, checks running before `save_file`) is correct.
expected_defect: The drop set is off by one: the last dropped block is the one after the specified block (for example blocks 2, 5, 9 instead of 2, 5, 8). Block counts still match, so the artifact's own checks pass.
